candidate: ordered active-membership register with mutable ordinal selection

state_types.ENTRY: one continuing written account/record; not a pictured panel identity
state_types.HISTORY: retained membership events; removal does not erase identity
state_types.DUTY: an action/content plus an explicitly bound recipient

finite_operations.name: CREATE_ENTRY
finite_operations.effect: create entry with active_order=[], membership_history=[], duties=[]

finite_operations.name: INTRODUCE_APPEND
finite_operations.effect: append the distinct member to active_order and record introduction in history

finite_operations.name: REMOVE_ACTIVE
finite_operations.effect: remove that identity from active_order, retain its history, do not renumber historical identities

finite_operations.name: CURRENT_COUNT
finite_operations.effect: return the cardinality of active_order at this point in written event order

finite_operations.name: CURRENT_SELECT
finite_operations.effect: select active_order[k] after all preceding written mutations; selection is recomputed and is unavailable if k exceeds current count

finite_operations.name: ASSIGN_DUTY
finite_operations.input: entry, explicitly written duty, recipient from a bound CURRENT_SELECT result
finite_operations.effect: record the duty and recipient identity; no implicit role inheritance from former rank

predeclared_differing_consequence.pass_requirement: The target must write and bind the duty X to CURRENT_SELECT(E,2) after the removal and append. A name list, restored count alone, or static rank-word hypothesis is not a pass.

uniformity_and_scope: The same operations apply to every corresponding member and every event; no locus/index-specific exception.
Member identities are trace placeholders only. A/E/B/C/D are not proposed glyph meanings or labels inherited from the drawing.
No numeric/ordinal reading of okal, okaly, or any suffix is imported.
All participants, mutation causes, operation order, count, selector, and duty must be explicitly bound by written constituents under a reusable construction.
Open groups cannot silently be treated as no-ops, separators, references, or event operators.
known_limits: This is only a finite nonlexical semantic contract, not evidence that f83r writes any operation.
A written roster count does not entail that membership was dynamically mutated.
The test is exploratory on previously exposed text and offers no independent confirmation.
